Proposition
[harmonic tensors and constant trace]

Source: petersen:page-0364 ↗ def:pet-ch9-codazzi-harmonic-tensor 1. ch9:9.4.4For a symmetric $(0,2)$-tensor $h$, \[ h ext{ is harmonic}\quad \Longleftrightarrow \quad d^ abla h=0 ext{ and }\operatorname {tr}h ext{ is constant}. \]
Proof

↗ prop:pet-ch9-harmonic-iff-codazzi-constant-trace \sketch In a normal frame, symmetry of $h$ gives

\[ ( abla ^*h)(X)=-D_X\operatorname {tr}h +\sum _i(d^ abla h)(X,E_i,E_i). \]

For a Codazzi tensor the final sum vanishes, so divergence freedom is equivalent to constancy of the trace.

□

In particular, a constant-mean-curvature hypersurface has harmonic second fundamental form. By subsection 4.3, a Codazzi Ricci tensor is equivalent to divergence-free curvature.
